summary: Frontend-only verification for (1) Provider Directory page, (2) MOD site card assign/change/remove overseas provider, and (3) IssueDetailPanel 'Notified when logged' panel. Provider Directory and MOD site assign/change/remove all WORK end-to-end. The Notified panel could NOT be verified because (a) the LiteDashboard Faults tab 'Log New Fault' path posts to /api/issues (not the MOD-specific /api/mod/site/faults) so notified_recipients is never written, and (b) the MODFaultWizard (which posts to /api/mod/site/faults and has the onset/usable/safe fields the task references) is imported in AppRoutes but has NO active Route mounted, so it is unreachable from the UI.

minor.issue: MOD site portal LiteDashboard 'Log New Fault' submits here; this path does NOT write notified_recipients / does not run the Pulse+overseas dual-notification logic. Only /api/mod/site/faults does. Confirmed via DB check on newly created issue b39c5106… — no notified_recipients field persisted.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Notified when logged' panel (data-testid issue-notified-log-<id>) never renders on faults logged from the MOD portal because the UI submits to /api/issues which does not persist notified_recipients. Only the older issue-supplier-sent badge shows.

MODSiteDashboard/MODFaultWizard (data-testid mod-log-fault-btn / mod-fault-wizard) is imported but no <Route> in AppRoutes.js mounts MODSiteDashboard — the guided wizard with fault_type/onset/usable/safe_in_service fields described in the task is unreachable from the MOD site login (which lands on /pulse LiteDashboard).

rca of the issue: Missing UI wiring: (1) LiteDashboard Faults tab (the only reachable fault-logging path for MOD-site users after login) posts to /api/issues which is the generic endpoint, not /api/mod/site/faults. Since backend writes notified_recipients only in mod_fault_submit, faults logged from UI carry no notification log. (2) MODFaultWizard (the guided wizard whose fields the task describes) is imported but MODSiteDashboard has no active route — so the correct wizard is unreachable. Both need to be addressed together for the 'Notified when logged' panel to appear.
